extracted.stage: Divorce financial remedy proceedings, next hearing listed
extracted.summary: A partner at Ashcroft & Varga Law enquires about a £27,000 litigation loan for a wife in divorce proceedings with around £233,500 of assets in dispute and a hearing at the Central Family Court on 20 October 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have received and logged. To progress matters we would be grateful for the client's full name and contact details, confirmation of the nature of the assets in dispute and any evidence of their value, details of the proceedings including the case number and the nature of the October hearing, and a costs estimate or breakdown for counsel, the forensic accountant and your own fees. We will also send our criteria and application form separately. Once we have the above, a member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you.
